paragraphs: Encartele sells communication and digital services to correctional facilities, and describes itself as the first internet applications provider for corrections. The company says those services reach over 450 facilities.

Alongside inmate communications, one line of work is smart sensor technology that measures and monitors indoor environments in correctional facilities. Another is a digital ecosystem for incarcerated individuals and their families, with community tools, financial services, and purposeful engagement. A third is an invite-only community where corrections professionals share ideas and gather intelligence. These sit on the company's own platform, the foundation of what it calls its suite of CID solutions.

Encartele was founded in 2004 through the merger of call center technology and inmate communications systems. It has been headquartered in Omaha, Nebraska, ever since. The site credits business owner Scott Moreland with directing the company as the corrections industry changed. Encartele also runs an annual training and networking event for corrections professionals.
